2023-02-09
Claim opened after the insured reported a sideswipe that occurred while the other driver was changing lanes. The
claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact is being routed through the attorney's office.
2023-03-19
Photos taken at the scene show damage consistent with the described impact, and the repair estimate reflects the
same panels. Police records and the statements of people at the scene confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the
time. No independent witnesses have come forward to add to the account.
2023-05-25
The claimant's neck strain is consistent in type and severity with the force of a side impact of this kind. No prior injury
to the same body area appears in the records we have reviewed. The driver is named on the policy, and nothing in
the file suggests the vehicle was damaged before coverage began.
2023-07-26
Treatment has followed a typical course, with physical therapy and follow-up visits that became less frequent as the
claimant's condition improved. The claimant has given the same account of the collision in each conversation so far,
including through counsel.
2023-08-06
No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or inspection notes. The repair scope matches the
photographs and the reported point of contact on the vehicle.
2023-08-30
File reviewed and details checked against the photos, police report, and mdeical records. Findings so far are
consistent across sources, and the claim will prcoeed to settlement review with counsel's correspondence on file.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
